title: Tegner
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Ask the patient to identify their current level from the graded list rather than describing their activity in their own words.
Ask them also to identify their level before the injury, since the drop is the informative quantity.
Record both values with the date.
Record the sport and the position, because the same level covers different demands.
Record it alongside a symptom score rather than on its own.
Avoid converting the level into a percentage, since it is an ordered list rather than a measurement.
- The levels are not an interval scale and should not be averaged.
